channel.title: Graveyard Keeper 2 Wiki
channel.description: An unofficial player-made wiki for Graveyard Keeper 2: the console-commands and cheats truth, beginner guides, and troubleshooting for every progression blocker. Verified and dated after every game update.

item.title: Graveyard Keeper 2 Factory Automation Guide — Conveyors and Iron
item.description: Unlock the underground factory, wire your first conveyor line, keep the Zombie Carousel powered, and run the four-step iron supply chain to the town warehouse.

item.title: Graveyard Keeper 2 Faith Guide — Earning It and Spending It
item.description: How faith works in Graveyard Keeper 2 — sermons and prayers on the income side, Inspiration and zombie work on the spending side, and why it feels slow early.

item.title: Graveyard Keeper 2 Money Guide — What Actually Earns Coin
item.description: The Graveyard Keeper 2 income streams that scale — village crops, the paint chain, town orders and church income — and the busywork that only looks like profit.

item.title: Graveyard Keeper 2 Zombie Workers Guide — Tasks, Setups and Fixes
item.description: How to unlock zombie workers, staff every station type, and fix idle or frozen zombies — quest names, techs and setups checked against current community data.

item.title: Graveyard Keeper 2 Cheats & Console Commands (October 2026) — The Truth
item.description: No working text codes or console commands have been documented for Graveyard Keeper 2 as of version 1.008. What works instead: the automation economy.

item.title: Graveyard Keeper 2 Beginner Guide — Your First Days in the Yard
item.description: The three engines of Graveyard Keeper 2 — graveyard and church, tech tree and town, and the automation economy — plus the order to unlock them in.

item.title: Graveyard Keeper 2 Troubleshooting — Steel, the Foundry & Blockers
item.description: Stuck on steel, the Royal Foundry, Polished Bronze, orders or zombie mining? The blockers that stall Graveyard Keeper 2 runs most, and how to unstick them.
